description: Observe the Total Solar Eclipse of August 21, 2017 (the Great American Eclipse) at the moment of totality from Hopkinsville, Kentucky — the point of greatest eclipse in the US. Navigate to the correct location (Hopkinsville, KY: 36.8656° N, 87.4886° W), set the date and time to approximately 18:24 UTC on August 21, 2017, find the Sun, and center the view on it so the total eclipse is visible with the Moon fully covering the solar disk.
